newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Portugal shares gain lifted by foreign mood.
newsitem.headline: Portugal shares gain lifted by foreign mood.

text.p: 1145 GMT - Shares were gaining, lifted by the still buoyant international mood and some selective individual developments, with volume swollen by a special trade in Banco Comercial Portugues.
*Traders said that the trend was likely to continue as today saw banks and insurers closing their July positions. Investment funds closed their July books on Wednesday.
*Portucel was gaining over four percent after it announced a 20 ecu rise in pulp prices to 510 ecu per tonne. The stock was at 1,597 escudos but facing resistance at 1,600, traders said.
*Engil was another strong performer after announcing it was in talks on Wednesday with fellow construction group Edifer to unite in a new venture.
*Portugal Telecom was recovering some of its losses of recent sessions, rising 1.5 percent against the overall PSI .PSI20 index rise of 0.65 percent.
*Banco Pinto & Sotto Mayor pushed ever higher, up 2.2 percent at 2,144 escudos, ahead of its first half results due later on Thursday. But sister bank Banco Totta was off 1.24 percent.

*But EDP continued to slip, losing 0.66 percent at 3,169. The stock is being weighed down by a number of factors including the fact that it is still trading at a premium to Spain's Endesa, traders said.
